round: V18 late game with probability-cutoff search
base: training/v7/base.ntd (= dist/models/ntuple-v8.bin; stage 1/2 tables identical to V4)
armsNotRun: C (4-ply, 0.01) omitted to save compute; decided before any V18 outcome.
pilot: 3-10 games per arm on seeds 99980001+ used only for cost estimates; excluded.
endpoint: Normal opening to first 6144 or real death; milestones 1536/3072/6144 recorded. 20000-move guard raises an error.
primary: B minus A probability of reaching 6144; paired 95% CI (normal approx.) and exact two-sided McNemar.

stopping: Fixed 1024 pairs; chunks interleaved across arms; no extension or early stop based on outcomes.
context: V4 website (3-ply / 24000 nodes, V4 model) reached 6144 in 14.88% of 5000 different openings (RL-V4-RESULTS.md); context only.
